title: VIBloom roots map, version 1
description: The map of a code project's assumptions, invariants and intentions (.vibloom/roots.json). Rules a schema cannot say: ids are unique; depends_on names existing ids, never the node itself, and the links form no cycle; each accepts id is one of the node's depends_on; a test with a tool needs a check of that tool, and checks lists each tool once. See docs/format.md.

$schema.description: The schema this file follows, for editors.

runner.description: The project's test command. Default: forge test --json.

report.description: Where the runner writes a JUnit XML report. Without it the runner's output is read as forge test --json.

timeout.description: Seconds a run (and each check's command) may take. Default 3600.

protect.description: Further paths only the person may change.

strict.description: Count unreviewed nodes as needing attention. Default false.

ignore_failures.description: Globs (* and ?) on Contract.test or a test's file: failing tests no node rests on that may pass.

checks.description: Reports of other tools that decide nodes.

path.description: A path from the project root: no leading /, no . or .. segments, no backslash; a folder ends in /.

report.description: The file the tool writes: halmos --json-output, echidna --format json, or JUnit XML.

command.description: Run by check before reading the report, which is deleted first. Without it the report must be newer than every file its nodes watch.

tool.description: The check whose report holds the result. Without it, the project's runner.

file.description: The test's source file in the project.

contract.description: The test's contract, or a JUnit classname.

name.description: The test's name; a Solidity signature loses its parameters.

stance.description: Default: hypothetical for an assumption, adopted otherwise.

depends_on.description: This node rests on these: if one fails, this is at risk.

protected.description: Only the person may edit its test. Default true for an invariant.
